description: This file defines data models and validation logic for shared channels and related entities in Mattermost, including shared channel structures, remote cluster info, user synchronization, and plugin registration options.

classes.name: SharedChannel
classes.description: Represents a shared channel that can be synchronized with remote clusters, including validation and pre-save/update hooks.

classes.name: SharedChannelRemote
classes.description: Represents a remote cluster invited to a shared channel, including validation and pre-save/update hooks.

classes.name: SharedChannelRemoteStatus
classes.description: Status information for a remote shared channel.

classes.name: SharedChannelUser
classes.description: Tracks synchronization timestamps for users in shared channels.

classes.name: SharedChannelAttachment
classes.description: Tracks synchronization timestamps for file attachments in shared channels.

classes.name: MembershipChangeMsg
classes.description: Represents a change in channel membership.

classes.name: SyncMsg
classes.description: Payload for content changes sent to remote clusters, including posts, reactions, statuses, and membership changes.

classes.name: SyncResponse
classes.description: Response to synchronization events, including update timestamps and error lists.

classes.name: RegisterPluginOpts
classes.description: Options provided by plugins when registering as a shared channels remote, including feature flags.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the shared channel object before saving, sanitizing strings and setting timestamps.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps and sanitizes strings before updating the shared channel.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the shared channel remote object.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes ID and timestamps before saving a shared channel remote.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamp before updating a shared channel remote.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the shared channel remote status object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the shared channel user object.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes ID and timestamps before saving a shared channel user.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the shared channel attachment object.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes ID and timestamps before saving a shared channel attachment.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns JSON string representation of SyncMsg.

methods.name: GetOptionFlags
methods.description: Returns feature flags based on plugin options.
